entry.title: dotnet/efcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-08-26
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • entry.CurrentValues.TryGetValue<object> throws System.InvalidCastException when accessing long property. #36661
  • Unify handling of "IsBusy" across the SQLite provider #36658
    Backlog
  • SQL Server: translate Contains over collections to the new SQL Server 2025 JSON_CONTAINS() #36656

Closed

  • ChangeTrackers FixupSkipNavigations throws NullReferenceException #35920
  • [Benchmarks] Benchmarks don't build anymore #36471
    10.0.0
  • Correct small inefficiency in private internal function in EFCore - FindIndexerPropertyInfo #34823
    10.0.0
  • Operating on Enum Flags using Enum.GetValues result in wrong SQL generated (_ord) #35821
    10.0.0
  • [10.0] New translations and SQL optimization/simplification #34846
    10.0.0
  • Support SQL Server 2025 CREATE JSON INDEX #36654
  • Concurrency token check skipped on TPT derived-only updates #36633

PullRequests

Created

  • [rc2] Add a test for default owned collection mapping #36663
    tell-mode
  • [rc2] Revert migrator behavior to use a transaction for each migration (when possible) #36662
    ask-mode
  • Implement ExecuteUpdate support for complex JSON #36659
  • Fix "IsBusy" problem when calling NextResult and disposing data record. #36657
  • [rc2] Handle escaping in JSON consistently by using JSON_VALUE with JSON_MODIFY #36653
    ask-mode
  • [rc2] Fix InvalidCastException in ToDebugString when using IncludeAnnotations with RuntimeNavigation #36651
    ask-mode

Merged

  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/10.0' => 'main' #36660
  • [rc2] Optimize FindIndexerPropertyInfo methods to avoid unnecessary reflection calls #36648
    ask-mode
  • [release/10.0-rc1] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #36655
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/10.0' => 'main' #36645
  • [release/10.0-rc1] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #36652
